items.title: Bill Matthews Interview, 1959-03-10
items.q: And Laura Dutre. He was the only one. Every time you pull out orchestration. Where's my part? He didn't worry about no trauma part. Give me the shallow part.

ctx.x: Yeah. I call all the best. Yeah. Them was. They used the trauma as a slice. And Laura Dutre. He was the only one. Every time you pull out orchestration. Where's my part? He didn't worry about no trauma part. Give me the shallow part. Ha. Ha. Ha. Ha. And Zu Raffling across his leg and make more stuff on the horn. The man can make on the saxophone.
How was Roy Palmer? What style did he have?
